answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the nectar of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the violet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
